abb-bing-1.webp.zh: 阿萨巴国际机场俯瞰：弧顶航站楼与深色塔台立在跑道一侧，近处红白相间的消防站和油罐车清晰可见。
abb-bing-1.webp.en: Aerial view of Asaba International Airport: the arched terminal roofs and dark control tower beside the runway, with the red-and-white fire station and a fuel truck down in the foreground.

abb-bing-2.webp.zh: 航站楼正面与站前停车场：拱形主立面中央嵌着三角形玻璃幕墙，塔台立在画面左侧。
abb-bing-2.webp.en: The terminal front and its car park — a triangular glass curtain wall set into the arched façade, with the control tower to the left.

abb-bing-3.webp.zh: 从停机坪一侧望向航站楼：白色弧顶建筑与独立塔台，近景是高杆灯下的机坪。
abb-bing-3.webp.en: The terminal seen from the apron: white vaulted roofs beside the freestanding control tower, under rows of floodlight masts.
